name: Hellbent
source:
Hunting demons is easy for you. Being magically bound to a snarky heir to Hell whose lights you can't even punch out? That’s where things get complicated.

A seductive underworld is hiding in plain sight, full of secrets, temptation, and demonic creatures you were raised to destroy. But when you find yourself in an unlikely alliance with one, every rule you’ve ever lived by gets tested, and duty might not be the only thing on the line. Especially if your demon hunter partner has anything to say about it.

[From [url=https://mailchi.mp/pixelberrystudios/choicesinsiderssept26?e=cc744d400b]Choices Insiders[/url]]
